ruling.recommended_action: Refund the unexempted off-route distance component (5.15 km × $1.41/km = $7.26) to the rider as a Ryde voucher per NS-7, and issue a route-deviation warning to the driver; flag the driver account for review given 2 upheld route disputes in 90 days. + flag_account

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 12:12–12:22 adds 5.15 km (6.47 km driven vs 1.32 km optimal, up to 1194 m from the optimal route). No RD-5 exemption: chats [F7][F8] contain no route-change proposal or rider agreement before the deviation; driver's GPS-reroute claim [F9] is not passenger consent and system records override it. No RD-4 exemption: no traffic incident on the optimal route [F12]; speed bands 4 and 5 [F10][F11] are above band 2 and per RD-4(b) cannot excuse a detour on their own. No passenger-requested stop or reroute. Segment is unexempted → RD-2 refund applies.
